p=Path('programs/task-313d3ef7.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    separator=next((r for r,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==2 for v in row)),None)
    if separator is None:
        return g
    bg=g[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if r!=separator and g[r][c]!=bg]
    if not cells:
        return g
    # Slide the colored shape toward the full-width divider until adjacent.
    top=min(r for r,c,v in cells)
    bottom=max(r for r,c,v in cells)
    if bottom < separator:
        shift=separator-1-bottom
        marker_row=top+shift-1
    else:
        shift=separator+1-top
        marker_row=bottom+shift+1
    for r,c,v in cells:
        g[r][c]=bg
    for r,c,v in cells:
        g[r+shift][c]=v
    # Mark the row immediately behind the translated shape.
    if 0 <= marker_row < h and marker_row != separator:
        g[marker_row]=[8]*w
    return g
''')
